title: Save a schematic document in ASCII format
summary: Saves a copy of the active schematic sheet through a named save filter with IServerDocument.DoFileSave, keeping the open document on its own file.
phrasings: save a schematic copy in ascii format
save a document with a specific file format
write a schematic to another file without renaming it

commands.name: SaveToAscii
commands.description: Save the active schematic in ASCII format
commands.params: Out=<file or existing folder> (optional, default temp folder)|Format=<save filter> (optional, default 'Advanced Schematic ascii')|Keep=true (optional)
